name: Cutting Yourself
overview: Scripture explicitly forbids making cuttings or marks in the flesh as a form of mourning or for the dead, emphasizing that believers are the children of the LORD and should honor Him by refraining from such practices (Leviticus 19:28; Deuteronomy 14:1). Instead of self-inflicted harm, the Bible points believers to the LORD’s nearness to those who are brokenhearted and contrite in spirit, offering true comfort and salvation (Psalms 34:18). This assurance is grounded in the unshakable love and power of God, who is sovereign over all things, both seen and unseen (Romans 8:38).
